title: Fields of The World: Field Boundaries for Estonia
description: Estonian agricultural field boundaries for 2021 from the INSPIRE GSAA (Geospatial Aid Application), originally provided by The Agricultural Registers and Information Agency (PRIA). The dataset includes field-level attributes such as land use classification, requested culture, and crop detection status.

_readme.text:
## Description

Geospatial Aid Application Estonia Agricultural parcels. The original dataset in obtained from the INSPIRE theme GSAA ( specifically Geospatial Aid Application Estonia Agricultural parcels) and download service provided by PRIA, through which the data layer Fields and Ecological Areas (GSAA) is made available. The data comes from the PRIA database.

This dataset is later on adapted by Eurocrops then its subset consumed by the fieldscapes project.

_The field boundaries are valid for the year 2021_

- **Source Data Provider:** [EuroCrop](https://zenodo.org/records/8229128/files/EE_2021.zip?download=1)
- **Original Data Provider:** [The Agricultural Registers and Information Agency](https://inspire-geoportal.ec.europa.eu/srv/eng/catalog.search#/results?country=ee&view=IACSOverview&theme=none&iacs=gsaa&legislation=none&envdomain=none&basedomain=0)
- **Converted by:** Kerner Lab (ASU)
- **License:** CC-3.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326
